description.en: A simple blue cheese dip made with cottage cheese, served with cut vegetables.
description.he: דיפ גבינה כחולה פשוט עם גבינת קוטג׳, מוגש עם ירקות חתוכים.

he: מערבבים את כל המרכיבים יחד בבלנדר.

ocrRawText:
Dip
4 oz. blue cheese
8 oz cottage cheese
dash of skimmed milk
garlic powder
Blend ingredients & serve with cut
vegetables.
rankingReason: Result B has a more descriptive title ('Blue Cheese Dip' vs just 'Dip'), better Hebrew translations (natural phrasing like 'דיפ גבינה כחולה' and 'מנה ראשונה' vs 'מתאבן'), more detailed instructions ('Blend all ingredients together' is clearer than 'Blend ingredients'), includes 'snack' as an additional relevant tag, and properly assigns 'dash' as a unit for skimmed milk rather than leaving it null. The ingredient list formatting is also more consistent.
